description: This file defines the 'Request' class within the WebSockets::JsonRpc namespace, which inherits from a base Message class. It declares methods for creating a JSON-RPC request, retrieving its ID, and converting it to a string. It includes a static atomic counter for generating unique IDs.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC request with capabilities to create and serialize the request, and manages a unique ID sequence.

methods.name: ~Request
methods.description: Default destructor for the Request class.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new JSON-RPC request with specified method name and parameters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID associated with the request.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes the request object to a string format.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Generates a new unique ID for requests.
